## Specific task description

Task instruction: Set the smooth metal bell onto the rectangular base displaystand using the right arm.

Task description: Use the right arm to place the silver metal bell with a black base, currently on the right side of the table, on the black rectangular display platform toward the front center.

Success criteria: The metal bell is on the display stand surface, with its position close to the stand in both left-right and front-back directions; both grippers are open at completion.

## Execution tips

- Prioritize opposing outer edges of the bell's lower black base where the pads can seat toward each other. Set the opening to actual grasp width and avoid the top button and smooth domed slopes to reduce slipping.
- Before closing, confirm that the fingers are actually on opposite sides of the grasp area, the pads have sufficient contact, and the fingertips are not touching the table; avoid mere visual overlap without effective enclosure.
- Leave height clearance for both the bell bottom and fingertips when crossing the display stand edge. Avoid brushing the edge or raised strip on the side nearer the robot and shifting the stand.
- Place the bell base on a flat supporting surface, clear of raised ridges. Release the right gripper gradually after the platform supports the bell, avoiding release while suspended or a tilted base resting on an edge.
